experiment: Property/counterfactual sweep of the capture-envelope decision surfaces: analytic evaluator trajectories + 3^9 severity lattice + parameterized ffmpeg degradation sweeps through the real measurement pipeline

method.tooling: ffmpeg version 4.4.2-0ubuntu0.22.04.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2021 the FFmpeg developers
method.bases: 1 synthetic scene (frozen testsrc2 background + moving textured player patches) + 2 committed non-held-out real corpus clips (wm-volley-02, afn-sasebo-rally1), each re-encoded once (libx264 crf18) as shared control
method.holdout: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 never opened, read, or referenced by any sweep
method.monotonicityRule: along each axis every step is strictly-worse capture than the previous; any measured dimension or overall verdict IMPROVEMENT between adjacent steps is a violation
method.noTuning: no thresholds changed; this maps the surface without moving it
